regions.label: <house 1>
regions.prompt: Two-story coastal-style house with dark gray cedar shake siding and crisp white trim. The complex roofline features dark shingles and multiple gables with decorative white trusses. On the image-right, a gabled porch with white columns and a sunburst-patterned truss shelters a white front door. A set of gray stairs with black railings and white posts leads up to this porch. Windows are white-framed with multi-pane grids; three are visible on the upper level and four on the lower level, some glowing with warm interior light. A white horizontal band separates the two floors. The house sits on a light gray foundation over a flat green lawn.

regions.label: <roof 1>
regions.prompt: Multi-gabled roof with dark charcoal shingles and thick white fascia boards. Two prominent forward-facing gables feature white decorative truss patterns with vertical and diagonal braces in their peaks. The gable on the image-left sits above a small white-framed window, while the larger gable on the image-right covers a set of three white-framed windows. A lower, horizontal roof section with matching dark shingles extends across the bottom center, sheltering a porch area. All roof edges are sharply defined by the white trim against the dark textured shingles.

regions.label: <porch 1>
regions.prompt: Front porch with a gabled dark-shingled roof and a white decorative sunburst truss in the gable peak. Two square white columns with decorative capitals support the roof, resting on a light-gray stone foundation. A white front door with six glass panes and a black handle is recessed behind the columns. Black railings with thin vertical balusters line the porch edge and the light-gray concrete steps leading up to it. The railings are punctuated by white square posts with pyramid-shaped caps. To the image-right, the house wall features gray cedar shake siding and two white-trimmed windows.

regions.label: <stairs 1>
regions.prompt: A set of light-gray concrete stairs leading up to a porch landing. The stairs are flanked by black metal railings with thin vertical spindles. White square wooden posts with pyramid-shaped caps anchor the railings at the base of the stairs, the landing, and the top of the first flight. The landing and stairs are part of a house with a light-gray textured foundation and gray shingle siding visible in the background.

regions.label: <window 1>
regions.prompt: Three identical, side-by-side vertical rectangular windows set into a grey shingled wall. Each window features a thick white frame and is divided into twelve small panes by thin white muntins in a three-by-four grid. The glass panes are dark grey with subtle vertical reflections.

regions.label: <window 2>
regions.prompt: A trio of identical, vertically oriented rectangular windows set side-by-side. Each window features a thick white frame and is divided into nine smaller panes by thin white muntins in a three-by-three grid. The glass panes are dark gray with subtle vertical reflections. The windows are mounted against a wall of dark gray cedar shingles.

regions.label: <window 3>
regions.prompt: White-framed rectangular window with six panes arranged in two columns and three rows, separated by thin white muntins. The glass panes are dark and non-reflective. A thick white sill projects slightly from the bottom of the frame against a background of dark grey shingles.

regions.label: <window 6>
regions.prompt: Vertical rectangular window with a thick white frame and sill, set against dark grey shingles. The window is divided into two sashes: the top sash contains six panes in a three-by-two grid glowing with warm yellow light, while the bottom sash contains six dark panes in a matching three-by-two grid.

regions.label: <window 7>
regions.prompt: Tall, narrow rectangular window with a thick white frame and prominent sill, set against dark grey shingle siding. The window is divided vertically; the image-left pane glows with a warm golden light and is subdivided by thin white muntins, while the image-right pane is a single, dark grey glass surface.

regions.label: <plain 1>
regions.prompt: A flat, grassy plain. A long shadow is cast onto the grass at the image-left.

regions.label: <shadow 1>
regions.prompt: A dark, elongated shadow cast across a textured, olive-green grassy field. The shadow's upper edge forms a large, solid geometric block that angles from the top-left towards the center. Below this, thinner, parallel horizontal bands of shadow stretch across the lower half of the crop, with the bottom-most band featuring a serrated, comb-like edge on its right side.

regions.label: <sky 1>
regions.prompt: Clear, pale blue sky with a subtle horizontal gradient, transitioning from a slightly deeper blue at the top to a very pale, almost white hue near the horizon line. The sky is completely cloudless and uniform in texture.

prompt:
This is a 3d_render of a two-story <house 1> situated on a flat, grassy <plain 1>. The style is clean and architectural, with a neutral color palette of dark gray shingles, white trim, and black roofing. The lighting is bright and even, casting a long, soft shadow from the <house 1> onto the <plain 1> to the image-left.

The <house 1> is shown from a high-angle, three-quarter perspective, revealing its front and left side. The exterior walls are covered in dark gray cedar-style shingles. A white horizontal band separates the first and second floors. The roof is composed of multiple gables with black asphalt shingles and white fascia boards. The gables feature decorative white wooden trusses.

On the front-facing side of the <house 1>, a covered porch with a gabled roof and white support columns extends from the center. A set of gray concrete <stairs 1> with black metal railings leads up to the porch from the bottom right. The porch has a black railing and a white front door with glass panes. To the image-right of the porch, there is a large white-trimmed window with six panes on the first floor and a similar three-pane window on the second floor. Above the porch, a smaller gabled section contains a single white-trimmed window.

The left side of the <house 1> features several white-trimmed windows. On the first floor, there are three windows: a small one near the back, a medium one in the middle, and a larger one near the front porch. On the second floor, there are two windows: one near the back and a larger one toward the front. All windows have white frames and multiple panes. The base of the <house 1> is a light gray concrete foundation.

The <plain 1> is a uniform, olive-green color with a subtle texture suggesting short grass. The horizon line is high in the frame, and the sky above is a pale, gradient blue-white, suggesting a clear day. The shadow of the <house 1> on the <plain 1> is dark and clearly defined, extending towards the image-left and slightly forward.
